Subject: Post-call recap + next step: technical deep-dive windows

Hannah / Kenji —

Thanks again for taking time this morning. Quick recap from our discovery call and a proposal for next steps so we keep momentum: 

Key points we heard:
- Primary goal: integrate low-latency document summarization into FinScale's customer support flows (sla ~200ms p50 on short requests).
- Data constraints: PII redaction required for EU accounts; will need VPC/private deployment conversation later.
- Volume: short bursts of high concurrency during EOD reporting windows (US/UK overlap).

Suggested next step: a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with our Solutions Engineer (Priyom) to go over architecture, sample payloads, and performance tradeoffs. Since your engineering stakeholders span APAC and EU as well as the US, I proposed a rotating set of demo times so the same team can join on alternating weeks without everyone staying late/early.

Proposed cadence (we can refine):
- Week A: 08:00 PDT / 16:00 BST / 00:00 JST — favors EU/US overlap
- Week B: 23:00 PDT / 07:00 BST / 15:00 JST — favors APAC/UK overlap
- Keep a fixed two-week rotation so your engineers only shift occasionally.

I attached our discovery notes and a tentative .ics for the two slots. Can you please: 
1) confirm which week (A or B) your engineering lead prefers for the first deep-dive,
2) share any strict blackout dates in the next 3 weeks, and
3) let me know if Priyom should cover model/serving details or include Marissa for pricing/capacity planning.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with a calendar poll link after I hear back.

Best,
Ben Carter
